Pills: `pill`, `pill-info`, `pill-pending`, `pill-ready`, `pill-missing`, `pill-present`.
Progress: `progress`, `progress-bar`.
Empty: `empty-state`, `empty-icon`, `empty-title`, `empty-text`. Spinner `spinner`.
Banners: `error-banner`, `success-banner`.
Modal: `modal-backdrop`, `modal`, `modal-header`, `modal-title`, `modal-body`, `modal-footer`.
Checkbox rows: `check-row`, `check-row-checked`, `checkbox`.
Icons: `icon-xs/sm/md/lg`.
